# GlueLam vendor (quantum gutter + DAC + steno + preflight)

Local copies for **offline / low-latency / quantum-speed path**.

Upstream: https://mueee.qbitos.ai/ · https://github.com/qbitOS/qbitos-gluelam

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `quantum-prefixes.js` | 11-symbol quantum gutter |
| `qbit-dac.js` | DAC tracks / .qbit |
| `qbit-steno.js` | stenoSTRIP |
| `qbit-preflight.js` | QPU preflight |

Loaded first by `js/gluelam-consumer.js` before remote mueee.
